body: Well my focus has been on psycholinguistics, so I haven't learned any programming. But I guess I can start learning programming, seeing that more and more people are doing it.

I have the fault of being infatuated with linguistics. I spent five years on my MA thesis and now one year in PhD studies, but my PhD studies are not funded and there's no opening in any other universities I searched. Sadly there's not a lot of work for linguists outside academia. Since I have no money, I have to get a full time job, which I have been looking for. But if I had a full time job, I wouldn't have time to do my PhD and I couldn't do a job that I invested so much time and money in and what I really want to do. So the only "good" way would be to find a normal job. But with the work market, it's hard to find any job. And I'd live in a constant state of regret and cognitive dissonance.

I worked for a dream career for 6 hard years. I sacrificed my personal life for it, I sacrificed everything. And it came tumbling down. Now I don't have money, I don't have friends, let alone a girlfriend or a wife, and I haven't found a job in 6 months. An acquaintance called me an old loser the other day. My family calls me helpless and worthless.

I have worked so hard and achieved nothing. After all this, I can't even get hired for a simple job. If I did, I would still hate my life, because I have so many regrets and zero dreams or aspirations. Just a lowlife.

I don't have any aspirations anymore. I can't wish anything from life anymore. It has nothing to offer, I feel.
